description: How much is being built, by municipality. flatin.pt's monthly count of municipal building-works cases entering the licensing pipeline (for the municipalities we collect), the change on the previous 12 months and per 1,000 residents, plus INE's official yearly licensed buildings and new dwellings for any of the 308 municipalities. Without `municipality` returns the summary and the panel index. A case is not a licence granted and not a building — the answer says so.

granularity.description: Period of our own series. Default: month

language.description: Language of the site content in the answer (verdicts, definitions, labels) and of the page links: pt, en, ru, ua (or uk), de, fr, nl. Field names and the summary stay English. Default: en

measure.description: Kind of works: total_works (default), new_build, alter_extend

municipality.description: Optional. Municipality name in any case, accents optional (Porto, Lisboa, Vila Nova de Gaia, Matosinhos; Lisbon and Oporto are accepted) or its four-digit code (1312). Close spellings are found; two matches return an `ambiguous` error with candidates. Omit for the summary of every municipality we collect

name: construction_barometer
title: Construction activity by municipality (barometer)
